title: flutter/flutter
claim: flutter/flutter — Flutter makes it easy and fast to build beautiful apps for mobile and beyond
why_good: Flutter's cross-platform capabilities allow for rapid development, which can significantly reduce time-to-market for new applications.
value: Companies pay for premium support, training, and custom development services to leverage Flutter for their app solutions.
risk: The risk lies in established players like Google or Microsoft potentially integrating similar features into their existing ecosystems, overshadowing independent offerings.
